title: The Future of Dentistry: How Technology Is Changing Dental Care in India
seoTitle: Future of Dentistry: How Technology Is Changing Dental Care
seoDescription: From digital X-rays and 3D scans to lasers, AI and tooth regrowth research: how technology is changing dental treatment in India.
excerpt: Digital X-rays, 3D scans, intraoral scanners, lasers and AI are changing how dentists diagnose and treat teeth. Here is what is already available in India, what is still experimental, and what it means for patients.
